MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:PLACED_IN]->(st:Store)
WHERE so.status = 'completed'
  AND st.country = 'DE'
  AND date_part('year', so.order_date) = 2023
MATCH (so)-[hl:HAS_LINE]->(:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
WITH sku, sum(hl.qty) as sku_qty
MATCH (sku)-[bm:MAPS_TO]->(m:Model)
WHERE sku.is_bundle = false
WITH m, sum(bm.qty * sku_qty) as model_qty
RETURN m.model_code
ORDER BY model_qty DESC
LIMIT 3

MATCH (bundle)-[b:BUNDLES]->(item:SKU)
WITH item, sum(b.qty * hl.qty) as item_qty

WITH m, sum(bm.qty * item_qty) as model_qty
RETURN m.model_code
ORDER BY model_qty DESC

MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:PLACED_IN]->(s:Store {country: 'CA'})
WHERE so.status = 'completed' AND date_part('year', so.order_date) = 2024
WITH so
MATCH (so)-[:HAS_LINE]->(l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
WITH so, l, sku, l.qty * so_line.unit_price as revenue
// Handle bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
OPTIONAL MATCH (sku)-[b:BUNDLES]->(item_sku:SKU)
WITH so, l, sku, item_sku, coalesce(b.qty, 1) * l.qty as item_qty
// If not a bundle, use original sku; if bundle, use item_sku
WITH so, l, CASE WHEN item_sku IS NULL THEN sku ELSE item_sku END as final_sku, 
     CASE WHEN item_sku IS NULL THEN l.qty ELSE item_qty END as final_qty
// Map to models
MATCH (final_sku)-[m:MAPS_TO]->(mod:Model)
WITH mod, sum(final_qty * m.qty) as model_units
RETURN mod.model_code
ORDER BY model_units DESC
LIMIT 3
